name: queryRegisterFunction
description: Registers a CFML user-defined function or closure so it can be called by name inside Query of Query (QoQ) SQL. type is scalar (the default) for a per-row function, or aggregate for a function that combines rows (usable with GROUP BY). The registered function stays available for the lifetime of the virtual machine.

params.name: name
params.description: The name to use for the function in QoQ SQL.

params.name: udf
params.description: The CFML function or closure to register.

examples.title: Custom scalar function
examples.description: Register a function that doubles a column value and use it in QoQ.
